card.name: Endings of place and foreign names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a rare proper name or foreign word split into parts, such as Owar-u, Oron-o, Cho Oyu, or Dutch 'even'. It appears in general web text, mostly geography and etymology.

modes.label: Place names

modes.label: Foreign or old words
modes.description: Piece of a foreign or Old English word being explained.
